description: Search offers by price, brand, body style, fuel, drive, provider, term, mileage, fees, power and equipment. All filters combine in one call. Each provider's car appears once, as its first matching offer in the sort order (default price-asc); variant_count tells how many offers it stands for. Returns short summaries, totals and results_url, the same search on abomio.de. For the next page, send next_cursor as cursor with the same filters and sort; null means no more pages. On publication_changed, search again without cursor. Hosts that support MCP Apps show the offers as cards with photo, price, terms, fees and links.

availableOnly.description: Omit or true for offers that are still offered. false also returns offers that are no longer offered.

body.description: Body style of the car. kleinwagen is a small car, kompaktwagen a compact hatchback, limousine a saloon, kombi an estate, suv an SUV or SUV coupé, coupe a coupé or sports car, cabrio a convertible, van a people carrier or minibus and transporter a panel van or pick-up. Offers of a model that is not classified yet do not match.

brand.description: Brand of the car, for example Volkswagen. A common short name such as VW finds the same brand.

camera_360.description: Filter by 360° camera: included keeps only cars with it, absent only cars without it. Offers without data on it match neither value.

cursor.description: Position of a later page: the next_cursor of the previous page. It works only with the same customer, filters and sort as that page. Without it, the search starts at the first page.

customer.description: Who signs the contract: a private person or a business. Without it, the search shows offers for private persons. Prices include VAT in both groups.

drive.description: Driven axle: frontantrieb (front-wheel), hinterradantrieb (rear-wheel) or allradantrieb (all-wheel). Offers with unknown or conflicting drive data do not match.

fuel.description: Engine type: elektro (battery electric), benzin (petrol), diesel, hybrid (not plug-in), plug_in_hybrid, verbrenner (combustion engine, fuel not stated) or unbekannt (not stated). mild_hybrid is an old value; mild hybrids are listed by the fuel they burn.

heated_seats.description: Filter by seat heating: included keeps only cars with it, absent only cars without it. Offers without data on it match neither value.

max_fees.description: Highest total of required one-time fees to include, in euros, such as delivery or a down payment. 0 keeps only offers without such fees. Offers whose fees are not known do not match.

max_price.description: Highest monthly rate to include, in euros with VAT. Use it for the user's budget, for example 500.

min_hp.description: Lowest power to include, in metric horsepower (PS). Use min_kw when the user gives kilowatts. Offers with unknown or conflicting power do not match.

min_km_year.description: Lowest yearly mileage that the contract must include, in kilometres, for example 30000 for a user who drives 30,000 km a year.

min_kw.description: Lowest power to include, in kilowatts. Offers with unknown or conflicting power do not match.

min_price.description: Lowest monthly rate to include, in euros with VAT. It must not be above max_price.

navigation.description: Filter by navigation system: included keeps only cars with it, absent only cars without it. Offers without data on it match neither value.

provider.description: The provider of the offer, by the provider_id that offers show, such as finn. /agent-instructions.md lists the providers that have offers now.

q.description: Free text in German, for example a model such as ID.4. Phrases for price, fees, PS, mileage or equipment, such as bis 500 or Navi, act as those filters. Each other word must appear as text in the brand, model, vehicle name, motor, equipment line, fuel, transmission or provider name. Prefer the other filters where one fits.

reversing_camera.description: Filter by reversing camera: included keeps only cars with it, absent only cars without it. Offers without data on it match neither value.

runtime.description: Contract term in months, for example 12. Only offers with exactly this term match.

sort.description: Result order: price-asc (lowest monthly rate first), price-desc (highest first), hp-desc (most power first) or name-asc (vehicle name A to Z).

trailer_hitch.description: Filter by trailer hitch: included keeps only cars with it, absent only cars without it. Offers without data on it match neither value.

transmission.description: Gearbox: automatik (automatic), manuell (manual) or unbekannt (not stated).

name: search_offers

checked_at.description: When abomio.de last checked the catalogue.

next_cursor.description: Send as cursor to read the next page. null when there are no more pages. Treat it as opaque.

availability.description: available: confirmed by the provider. stale: still listed, but not confirmed for 45 minutes. unavailable: no longer offered; since is when it left.

body_type.description: Body style of the car. kleinwagen is a small car, kompaktwagen a compact hatchback, limousine a saloon, kombi an estate, suv an SUV or SUV coupé, coupe a coupé or sports car, cabrio a convertible, van a people carrier or minibus and transporter a panel van or pick-up. Absent when abomio.de has not classified the model yet.

cost_coverage.description: complete: the provider's required costs are all recorded. partial or absent: more costs can apply. Get the offer for each recorded cost.

delivery_time.description: Delivery time in German, as abomio.de normalizes it.

drive_type.description: Driven axle: Allrad (all-wheel), Frontantrieb (front), Heckantrieb (rear) or Zweiradantrieb (two-wheel, axle unknown).

eligibility_note.description: Provider conditions on who can subscribe.

equipment.description: Equipment the provider states: true when the car has it, false when not. A missing field is unknown.

fuel_type.description: Engine type: elektro (battery electric), benzin (petrol), diesel, hybrid (not plug-in), plug_in_hybrid, verbrenner (combustion engine, fuel not stated) or unbekannt (not stated). mild_hybrid is an old value; mild hybrids are listed by the fuel they burn.

guaranteed_model.description: true: the provider supplies this model. false: the provider may supply a similar model.

id.description: Offer ID, unique within its provider. Use it with provider_id to read the full offer.

one_time_fees_eur.description: Sum of the recorded required one-time fees, such as delivery or a down payment. Absent when an amount is unknown. Deposits are not included.

price_per_month_eur.description: Monthly rate in euros, VAT included.

provider_host.description: Host of the provider page that source_url leads to, such as www.finn.com.

provider_id.description: The provider of the offer, by the provider_id that offers show, such as finn. /agent-instructions.md lists the providers that have offers now.

scraped_at.description: When abomio.de last read this offer from the provider.

source_url.description: Link to the offer on abomio.de. It counts the click and redirects to the provider's page, or to the model page when the offer is no longer available. Programs that open a link to FINN or SIXT also get the model page.

term_cost_eur.description: All monthly rates plus the recorded required fees over the full term. Absent when a required amount is unknown.

transmission.description: Gearbox: automatik (automatic), manuell (manual) or unbekannt (not stated).

variant_count.description: Matching offers of this car from this provider, such as other terms, mileage packages or colours. The row shows the first of them in the chosen sort. Narrower filters or results_url show the others.

vehicle.description: Vehicle names as abomio.de normalizes them.

path.description: Path of the model's comparison page on abomio.de, below /gewerbe for business-only offers. Absent when the model has no page.

published_at.description: When the published offers last changed.

results_url.description: The same search on abomio.de, with all matches in a table. Give it to people who want to see more offers. min_price has no equivalent there and is left out.

total.description: Matching cars on all pages. Each provider's car appears once.

total_offers.description: Matching offers on all pages, counting every variant.

title: Search car subscriptions
